verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official MCP server (github.com/auth0/auth0-mcp-server) documented at auth0.com/docs/get-started/auth0-mcp-server, enabling AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf to connect via secure OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization and perform multi-step tenant operations (create apps, manage users, deploy Actions). missing for 10: independent hands-on third-party review of the MCP server's reliability/security in production, and details on rate limits or scope granularity.
